captions.detailed: A thick, solid cylindrical puck or enclosure resembling the outer ring of a heavy-duty planetary gear bearing. The outer surface is mostly smooth and circular, with a small, stylized monogram emblem subtly debossed on one side. The overall proportions present a flat, wide disc shape with a clean, industrial appearance.
captions.instruction: Create a fully parametric planetary gear bearing assembly in OpenSCAD. The design must include an outer ring gear, a central sun gear, and multiple planet gears utilizing helical herringbone teeth, with parameters to control the outer diameter, thickness, tooth count, clearance, and number of planets.
captions.factory: The script constructs a planetary gear bearing assembly using custom mathematical involute gear generation. The outer ring is built by subtracting a herringbone gear profile and a monogram logo from a solid cylinder using the difference() operator. The planet gears are generated in a for-loop using the herringbone module, translated and rotated into position, and hollowed out with central planet holes. The sun gear is created as a separate module with a central axle hole, and can be split into two halves using the sunhalve module which slices the sun gear with a cylinder offset.
